summary: Quotations feature verified end-to-end (backend + admin UI + public /q). Backend pytest 14/15 pass (15/15 after client bug is fixed). Admin flow at 390x844: /admin-login demo -> /admin/quotations (list, sidebar entry present in nav-config), new-quotation-btn -> /admin/quotation/new (subject, body, toggle-pricing, add-item x2 with rates 30000+10000, gst cgst_sgst) -> save-quotation redirected to /admin/quotation/quo_aee2685d751f as QUO-0007 (Estimated ₹47,200 with CGST/SGST ₹3,600 each). share-quotation created share_url in share-url-box. convert-quotation -> convert-modal -> convert-invoice navigates to /admin/invoice/inv_c60721b1aeec; on return, view-converted-invoice card visible and convert-quotation hidden as spec'd. Public /q/{token} (light letterhead) shows Studio name, contact line, orange rule, 'QUOTATION' title, status badge (SENT -> REVISION REQUESTED), 'PREPARED FOR UI TEST Client', subject 'UI TEST Wedding Package', body, pricing table with GST rows, 'Estimated Total ₹47,200', amount-in-words, TERMS & CONDITIONS, accept-quotation + request-revision buttons, revision-box with revision-note + send-revision, download-quotation-pdf, and 'Powered by www.pikconnect.com' footer. After send-revision, public-response-box appears and accept/revision buttons hide. Admin /notifications receives 'Quotation changes requested' and 'Quotation accepted' entries. Public GET with unknown token returns 404, invalid action returns 400. Admin+public PDF endpoints return application/pdf (%PDF header, >1KB). Convert to proforma also works.

critical.issue: PATCH without a `client` (or `client_id`) field OVERWRITES the persisted client snapshot with the default placeholder `{name: 'Client'}`. Reproduced: create quote with client.name='REPRO_CLIENT' -> PATCH {"subject":"x"} -> GET returns client.name='Client'. Root cause: quotation_routes._compute_and_pack() unconditionally calls inv_routes._client_snapshot(studio_id, data.get('client_id'), client_override) even on partial updates. It must fall back to `existing['client']` / `existing['client_id']` when both are absent from the update payload. Same latent risk exists if any admin edits the quotation via the /admin/quotation/new?id= form and the payload omits client_id when a snapshot client (no client_id) was created inline.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Client name' TextField (line 209) has no testID. Automation had to fall back to placeholder 'e.g. Sharma Wedding'. Add testID='quote-client-name' for reliable testing.

action_items: FIX HIGH: quotation_routes._compute_and_pack must preserve existing['client_id'] & existing['client'] when the PATCH payload omits both — otherwise every subject/body/terms edit silently resets the client to 'Client'.
Add testID='quote-client-name' to the Client-name TextField in /app/frontend/app/admin/quotation/new.tsx (line ~209).
Optionally: after the fix, re-run `pytest backend/tests/test_quotations.py -n 0` — expected 15/15.
Consider also preserving `event_id` in _compute_and_pack (currently already read from existing, this is OK — verified).
critical_code_review_comments: quotation_service.render_quotation_pdf uses a robust fallback (retry after stripping ) which is nice, but silently swallows the underlying Exception — log the failure to help future debugging.

quotation_service.build_quotation_html footer: `Powered by {website} · www.pikconnect.com` prints the studio website twice when a studio has configured a different website; the template already handles the default case, but on a studio with website set the copy reads e.g. 'Powered by www.mystudio.com · www.pikconnect.com'. Consider dropping the leading site when it isn't pikconnect.com or simply always render 'Powered by www.pikconnect.com'.

quotation_routes.convert_quotation: when converting a no-pricing quotation the seeded invoice line-item has rate=0 which will produce a ₹0 draft invoice. Acceptable as it's a *draft*, but the admin should be warned in the UI convert modal.
public_quotation_respond does not clamp `note` length — a malicious client could send arbitrarily large notes. Consider max_length on RespondIn.note (Pydantic Field(max_length=2000)).
quotation_routes list_quotations returns up to 2000 docs and has no pagination — fine for now but note for later.
